Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "The First Seven Years" (1930) was released more recently than "Cinesound Varieties" (1934). Despite gathering accurate release years for both films, the Planner reversed the interpretation of those dates. This indicates a logical error during the comparison step, where the later year (1934) was mistakenly identified as being earlier than 1930. This failure to correctly compare the two years led directly to the wrong solution for the problem.
